package_info.why_malicious: Vulnerable to XML External Entity (XXE) attacks via SVG files, allowing attackers to trigger Denial of Service (DoS) or Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) by processing crafted SVG files with external DTD references.

execution_context.trigger: runtime (when SVG file is parsed by Batik)

malicious_snippets.code_snippet:
<!DOCTYPE svg SYSTEM "http://localhost:2323">
<svg version="1.1" baseProfile="full" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="100" height="20">
  <text x="5" y="15" fill="red">I♡XML!</text>
</svg>
malicious_snippets.code_behavior: Defines an SVG file with an external DTD reference. When parsed, the XML parser attempts to fetch the DTD from the specified URL (http://localhost:2323), causing the application to make an HTTP request to the target address.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: The use of an external DTD in a user-supplied SVG file is a classic vector for XXE attacks, which can be used for SSRF, DoS, or data exfiltration.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: Normal SVG files should not require external DTDs, especially from arbitrary or attacker-controlled locations. The application should not make network requests based on user-supplied image files.
malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: External DTDs are rarely used in legitimate SVG files, but may be used in some advanced XML workflows (not typical for images).
key_indicators: Presence of <!DOCTYPE ... SYSTEM ...> in user-uploaded SVG
External DTD reference to non-standard or internal URLs
Network requests triggered by parsing image files

attack_chain.action: Attacker uploads or submits a crafted SVG file containing an external DTD reference.
attack_chain.leads_to: Application parses the SVG file using Batik.

attack_chain.action: Batik's XML parser processes the external DTD reference, causing the server to make an HTTP request to the specified address (e.g., localhost:2323).
attack_chain.leads_to: Potential SSRF, DoS, or information disclosure depending on the target and response.

attack_chain.action: If the target is a local service or a slow/unresponsive endpoint, the server may hang or become unavailable (DoS).
attack_chain.leads_to: Denial of Service or further exploitation (e.g., port scanning, SSRF).

behavioral_signatures: Parsing of SVG files triggers outbound HTTP requests
Presence of external DTD references in user-uploaded SVG/XML files
Unusual network activity from image processing components
file_indicators: SVG files referencing internal or non-standard URLs in DTD
network_indicators: HTTP requests to localhost or internal IPs triggered by image parsing
Unexpected outbound connections from image processing servers
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Scan user-uploaded SVG files for external DTD references (<!DOCTYPE ... SYSTEM ...>). Monitor network activity from image processing components for unexpected outbound requests, especially to internal or localhost addresses. Flag or block SVG files that contain external entity declarations or DTD references.
